scope: Offline implementation verification for MOD-05, MOD-06 and TOOL-01. These are not completed product acceptance or paid-model benefit measurements.

tests.network: Local fixture endpoints only; no paid provider calls.

criteria.requirement: Bound Retry-After, jitter, aggregate retry budget and transient 400 recovery
Keep incompatible opaque history pinned and respect explicit route/variant choices
Show the next retry time, support cancellation and account for failed attempts
criteria.gap: The native retry projection carries attempt/reason/status but no future retry deadline. The legacy TUI explicitly avoids inventing a countdown for that producer. Failed HTTP attempt counts are retained, but this batch does not establish complete billing attribution for every failed request.

criteria.requirement: Record implementation PRs and current live-client acceptance
criteria.gap: Offline results are recorded here. Current-version live retry/cancellation and complete cost acceptance remain open.

criteria.requirement: Derive reasoning variants, provider options, context limits and media capabilities from catalog routes
Explain unsupported parameters/capabilities and avoid universal provider-specific switches
criteria.gap: The fixture pins unsupported media feedback and route-specific variant options. It does not cover every unsupported parameter or both TUI implementations in a current live-client capability matrix.

criteria.requirement: Record implementation PRs and live-client acceptance
criteria.gap: No new live-account capability matrix is claimed by this offline batch.

criteria.requirement: Bound read windows and searches while retaining source identity
criteria.gap: This batch does not establish the complete ignore-rule and LSP retrieval matrix.

criteria.requirement: Avoid repeated whole-file reads on large-file and unfamiliar-repository tasks
criteria.gap: Large whole-file reads are refused with window guidance. Fixture correctness does not establish model behavior on unfamiliar real repositories.

criteria.requirement: Measure localization correctness, extra provider turns and request volume
criteria.gap: Requires the VAL-01 task baseline and approved real-model budget. No latency, quality or cost improvement is inferred from the offline tool tests.

criteria.requirement: Record implementation PRs and benefit evidence
criteria.gap: Implementation and offline evidence are linked; benefit acceptance remains open.
